scope: 26 prior status-9 apps; fresh-data startup and observed Google IPC, plus separately authorized FotMob sign-in
scopeLimitations: A different saved baseline and current run are not a controlled registration intervention.
Status zero is a broker connection, not feature completion.
SocketBinder callback afterService attribution is approximate during concurrent connections.
Trace messages are sampled at power-of-two counts, so record counts are not operation counts.
Private screenshots and raw logs stay local.
These native processes share a UID; production per-app isolation is not validated.
